import cv2, numpy as np
from scipy import ndimage as ndi
from scipy.spatial import cKDTree
from skimage.graph import route_through_array
from rcb_brush import WangBrush, BRUSH_WANG, Sheet, _wang_footprint
import time, json
PX=.22185986964255727
MASK=cv2.imread('/app/target.png',0)<128
DIST=ndi.distance_transform_edt(MASK)*PX

def resample(p, spacing=.35, closed=False):
    p=np.asarray(p,float)
    if closed: p=np.vstack([p,p[0]])
    lens=np.linalg.norm(np.diff(p,axis=0),axis=1)
    arc=np.r_[0,np.cumsum(lens)]
    if arc[-1]<1e-6:return p[:1]
    t=np.linspace(0,arc[-1],max(2,int(np.ceil(arc[-1]/spacing))+1))
    return np.stack([np.interp(t,arc,p[:,j]) for j in range(2)],axis=-1)

def make_path(inset=.30,step=.55,spacing=.35):
    contours=[]
    for level in np.arange(inset,DIST.max(),step):
        cs,_=cv2.findContours((DIST>=level).astype('uint8'),cv2.RETR_LIST,cv2.CHAIN_APPROX_NONE)
        for c in cs:
            p=c[:,0].astype(float)*PX
            if len(p)<6:continue
            # Smooth raster stairsteps, retaining the silhouette.
            p=ndi.gaussian_filter1d(p,1.2,axis=0,mode='wrap')
            p=resample(p,spacing,True)[:-1]
            if len(p)>4:contours.append((level,p))
    contours.sort(key=lambda a:a[0])
    # Begin at the top, walking outer loops then gradually inward.
    path=[]; meta=[]
    cost=np.where(MASK,1+2/(DIST+.05),1e5)
    previous=None
    while contours:
        # Nearest contour in the next inset level.
        lev=contours[0][0]
        choices=[(i,c) for i,c in enumerate(contours) if c[0]<=lev+.001]
        if previous is None:
            i= max(choices,key=lambda a:len(a[1][1]))[0]
            level,p=contours.pop(i); j=np.argmin(p[:,1]);p=np.roll(p,-j,axis=0)
        else:
            opts=[]
            for i,(_,p) in choices:
                ds=np.linalg.norm(p-previous,axis=1);j=np.argmin(ds);opts.append((ds[j],i,j))
            _,i,j=min(opts);level,p=contours.pop(i);p=np.roll(p,-j,axis=0)
            # Route connectors through the ink, so openings remain clear.
            a=np.rint(previous[::-1]/PX).astype(int);b=np.rint(p[0,::-1]/PX).astype(int)
            direct=resample(np.stack([previous,p[0]]),.2)
            ij=np.rint(direct[:,::-1]/PX).astype(int)
            if DIST[ij[:,0],ij[:,1]].min()>=min(.55,level):
                connector=resample(np.stack([previous,p[0]]),spacing)
            else:
                route,_=route_through_array(cost,tuple(a),tuple(b),fully_connected=True,geometric=True)
                connector=resample(np.array(route)[:,::-1]*PX,spacing)
            path.extend(connector[1:].tolist())
        p=np.vstack([p,p[0]])
        path.extend(p.tolist());previous=p[-1]
        meta.append((float(level),len(path)))
    return np.array(path),meta

def metrics(ink):
    pred=ink>=.5;t=MASK
    dt=ndi.distance_transform_edt(~t)*PX;dp=ndi.distance_transform_edt(~pred)*PX
    b1=pred^ndi.binary_erosion(pred);b2=t^ndi.binary_erosion(t)
    d1=ndi.distance_transform_edt(~b1)*PX;d2=ndi.distance_transform_edt(~b2)*PX
    precision=(d2[b1]<=1).mean();recall=(d1[b2]<=1).mean()
    return dict(iou=(pred&t).sum()/(pred|t).sum(),coverage=(pred&t).sum()/t.sum(),stray=(pred&(dt>1)).sum()/t.sum(),boundary_f=2*precision*recall/(precision+recall),area=int(pred.sum()))

def simulate(path,press=1.,name='model'):
    sheet=Sheet('main',(-.1,0),1024,1024,PX/1000)
    b=WangBrush(BRUSH_WANG);ink=np.zeros((1024,1024),np.float32)
    pts=resample(path,.15)
    # approach sets direction of travel before pressing
    x,y=sheet.mm_to_world(*pts[0]); b.step(x,y,0)
    vx,vy=sheet.mm_to_world(*pts[1]); b.theta=np.arctan2(vy-y,vx-x)
    for X,Y in pts:
        x,y=sheet.mm_to_world(X,Y);b.step(x,y,press/1000)
        r=_wang_footprint(sheet,*b.root,b.theta if b.theta is not None else 0,b.w,b.d)
        if r:
            r0,c0,a=r;sl=np.s_[r0:r0+a.shape[0],c0:c0+a.shape[1]];np.maximum(ink[sl],a,out=ink[sl])
    cv2.imwrite('/app/output/'+name+'.png',np.uint8(255*(1-ink)))
    overlay=np.full((1024,1024,3),255,np.uint8);overlay[MASK]=(170,170,170);overlay[ink>=.5]=(0,0,0);overlay[(ink>=.5)&~MASK]=(50,50,240);overlay[MASK&(ink<.5)]=(240,160,50)
    cv2.imwrite('/app/output/'+name+'_overlay.png',overlay)
    return metrics(ink)
if __name__=='__main__':
    import argparse
    a=argparse.ArgumentParser();a.add_argument('--inset',type=float,default=.3);a.add_argument('--step',type=float,default=.55);a.add_argument('--press',type=float,default=1.0);args=a.parse_args()
    t=time.time();path,meta=make_path(args.inset,args.step)
    np.savez('/app/output/path.npz',path=path,meta=meta,press=args.press)
    print('path',len(path),'length mm',np.linalg.norm(np.diff(path,axis=0),axis=1).sum(),'contours',len(meta),'time',time.time()-t,flush=True)
    print(simulate(path,args.press), 'time',time.time()-t,flush=True)

"""Generate the fixed brush trajectory from target-derived continuous contours."""
import os,time,json,argparse
import cv2,numpy as np
from rcb_brush import Session
from plan import make_path,metrics,PX

def main():
    ap=argparse.ArgumentParser();ap.add_argument('--inset',type=float,default=.3);ap.add_argument('--spacing',type=float,default=.35);ap.add_argument('--step',type=float,default=.55);ap.add_argument('--press',type=float,default=1.);ap.add_argument('--name',default='trial');ap.add_argument('--score',action='store_true');args=ap.parse_args()
    begin=time.time();path,meta=make_path(args.inset,args.step,args.spacing)
    print('planned',len(path),'points',len(meta),'contours',flush=True)
    s=Session(instance='/app/instance.json');p=s.primitives();s.record_start()
    p['move_tip']([-.1,.15,.06],speed=.1,settle=5)
    p['move_tip']([-.1,.15,.025],speed=.03,settle=5)
    p['move_tip']([-.1,.15,.05],speed=.05,settle=5)
    x,y=s.geo.mm_to_world(*path[0]);p['move_tip']([x,y,.05],speed=.1,settle=5)
    # Approach from the direction of the first contour segment.
    unit=(path[1]-path[0]);unit/=np.linalg.norm(unit)
    bx,by=s.geo.mm_to_world(*(path[0]-unit*3))
    p['move_tip']([bx,by,.028],speed=.03,settle=4)
    p['move_tip']([x,y,.023],speed=.015,settle=6)
    p['move_tip']([x,y,.020-args.press/1000],speed=.005,settle=10)
    for i,xy in enumerate(path):
        x,y=s.geo.mm_to_world(*xy)
        q,ok,err=s.ik([x,y,.020-args.press/1000])
        if not ok:raise RuntimeError(f'IK failed {i}: {err}')
        s.step(q)
        if i%3000==0:print('path',i,'steps',s.n_steps,'elapsed',round(time.time()-begin,1),flush=True)
    p['hold'](15)
    p['move_tip']([x,y,.05],speed=.01,settle=10)
    acts=s.record_stop();s.save_trajectory(acts,f'/app/output/{args.name}.npz',meta=vars(args))
    cv2.imwrite(f'/app/output/{args.name}.png',s.canvas()[:,:,::-1])
    ink=s.ink();np.save(f'/app/output/{args.name}_ink.npy',ink)
    result=metrics(ink);result.update(steps=s.n_steps,strokes=len(s.strokes()),state_sha=s.state_sha(),elapsed=time.time()-begin)
    print('local',json.dumps(result),flush=True)
    if args.score:
        result['score']=s.score();print('official',json.dumps(result['score']),flush=True)
    json.dump(result,open(f'/app/output/{args.name}.json','w'),indent=2)
    s.close()
if __name__=='__main__':main()
